headline: Committee takes up seabird streetlight settlement and enters executive session

meeting.body: Maui County Council Government Relations, Ethics, and Transparency Committee
meeting.voteItem: Motion to enter executive session on Resolution 26-128
meeting.summary: The committee took up Resolution 26-128, a proposed settlement of a claim that streetlights threaten three protected seabirds, and voted to go into executive session. A county attorney said trial is likely in February, March or as late as April next year.
meeting.recap: The committee took up Resolution 26-128, a proposed settlement of a claim that streetlights threaten three protected seabirds.[[0:03:35]] A county attorney said trial may be set for February to April next year.[[0:05:11]] One caller testified, saying, “I'm on the seabird side.”.[[0:11:15]] Members voted 8–0 to meet in executive session (a closed-door discussion with their lawyers).[[0:16:07]] A county attorney said mediation (talks led by a neutral person) is set for August 10, 2026, at 9 a.m.[[0:22:17]] A caller asked for a recorded message every 15 minutes or so during executive session for phone listeners.[[0:25:07]] The case is set for trial on September 14, 2026.[[0:37:49]]
decided: Members voted to go into executive session on Resolution 26-128.
meeting.next: In the seabird case, a trial setting conference with the judge is expected, with trial likely in February, March or as late as April next year.
